capabilities: Render .html and .htm files in workspace tabs with local CSS, image, font and script assets resolved
Toggle between rendered preview and read-only source view
Embed HTML files in Markdown notes via an html-viewer fenced block
Search within the preview, jump to headings, and switch viewport widths
Print the preview or export it to PDF through the system print dialog
extras: Document scripts are disabled by default and only run per-file for trusted content; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian does not render local HTML files, so vault HTML documents can only be read as source code instead of being viewed as rendered pages.
summary: HTML file viewer that renders .html and .htm documents in Obsidian tabs or Markdown embeds with local asset resolution and sandboxed security.
